h1: AXOR bathroom installation in Stoke Poges

hero.intro: Stoke Poges is a village of large plots and substantial houses, from older period detached homes to more recent executive-style builds set well back from the road on sizeable gardens — and that scale of property is exactly where a digital or smart AXOR shower installation tends to get specified, because there's room for a proper walk-in shower or a second en-suite rather than squeezing a valve into an existing footprint. Getting an AXOR shower valve right in a property like this starts well before the final trim goes on: it starts at first fix, with the pipework, valve body and control wiring set out correctly before any wall closes around them, because an AXOR valve that's been positioned even slightly wrong is a problem you only discover once the tiling's finished.

sections.heading: What we install from AXOR in Stoke Poges
sections.body: AXOR is hansgrohe's design-led brassware brand, built around collaborations such as AXOR Starck, AXOR Citterio and AXOR Montreux, and the precision engineering behind every one of them extends to the digital and smart shower controls that pair with a modern valve system. In Stoke Poges, where the larger plots and period-to-executive housing mix gives us room to add a second en-suite or extend an existing bathroom, we install AXOR shower valves, digital control interfaces, basin mixers and bath fillers on a fit-only basis — you choose the range and finish, and we handle the plumbing and fitting.

sections.heading: Installation considerations specific to AXOR
sections.body: A digital or smart AXOR shower system has more going on behind the wall than a standard valve: a control module, wiring or a wireless control point, and a valve body that all need to be positioned exactly where the first-fix drawing says they will be, because there's no adjusting a buried valve once the wall's closed and tiled. We set this out carefully at first fix, checking the exact AXOR model against the manufacturer's installation requirements before any pipework is run. The finish is the other half of the job — a brushed or matte black AXOR trim shows every scuff mark from careless handling in a way chrome never does, so the control plate and handset stay boxed until the room is genuinely finished around them, and we sequence the later trades so nothing gets knocked once it's in place.

sections.heading: How Stoke Poges's housing stock affects a typical AXOR installation
sections.body: Stoke Poges' larger properties and sizeable gardens generally give us more flexibility to reposition a waste run or add a second en-suite than a smaller terraced property would allow, which matters when a digital AXOR system needs a specific pipe run to work properly. In the older period detached homes, that often means working around an existing layout that's never had a digital shower run through it, so we check structural depth and existing pipe routes at survey; in the more recent executive-style builds, the void space is usually already generous enough that the main task is simply confirming it against the exact AXOR model specified.

sections.heading: Fit-only, from £3,500
sections.body: We work fit-only across Stoke Poges: you source your AXOR brassware, sanitaryware and tiles, and we handle the strip-out, first fix, tiling, plumbing and final fit, from £3,500. Every project starts with a fixed-price £125 survey, deducted from your project cost if you go ahead, where we confirm the exact AXOR model, valve type and control system against what's been specified, so the first-fix drawing is right before a single pipe is run. With 30 years' experience fitting brassware at this level, we plan the programme around getting the hidden first-fix detail right, not just the visible finish. If something needs attention later, repairs start from £200, with a £500 minimum for an emergency call-out and no standalone regrouting offered.

faqs.q: Why does first fix matter so much for a digital AXOR shower?
faqs.a: A digital or smart AXOR system has a control module and valve body set behind the wall, and once it's tiled over there's no repositioning it — so we confirm the exact layout against the manufacturer's requirements before any pipework goes in.

faqs.q: Can you fit AXOR into a second en-suite in a larger Stoke Poges property?
faqs.a: Yes. Stoke Poges' larger plots and sizeable gardens generally give us more room to add or extend an en-suite than a smaller property allows, and we plan the AXOR valve run accordingly.

faqs.q: Will a brushed or matte black AXOR control plate show marks if it's fitted early?
faqs.a: Yes — which is why we keep the control plate and handset boxed until the room is genuinely finished, rather than fitting them early and risking damage from other trades.

faqs.q: Do you supply the AXOR shower system, or do I need to buy it myself?
faqs.a: We work fit-only, so you source your AXOR shower system through a showroom or supplier, and we handle the first fix, plumbing and final installation.

faqs.q: What happens at the £125 survey for an AXOR installation?
faqs.a: We go through the exact AXOR model, valve type and control system you've specified, confirm it against the property's layout, and set out the first-fix plan before anything is booked in.
